competitiveTarget: Beat portal city-directory pages — a real editorial destination with verified per-city photography and a live regional pulse, not a link farm. Now in the kinetic-brutalist design language.
note: KB (kinetic-brutalist) design — Phase 9 page-class migration. RESTYLED IN PLACE from the Experience System Geo hub v3.2: every section, stat, sentence, link, image, and JSON-LD preserved, only the presentation moved onto the KB visual language (navy #102742 + cream #faf8f4 surfaces, Amboqia display place names, hard --edge borders, .mono-num stats, the .section/.wrap rhythm). Structure: live region pulse hero (getRegionPulse — active count, median list, months-of-supply verdict) -> featured city editorial rows (full-width, alternating photo/content, VERIFIED cityHero() photography with labeled regional fallback, live per-city stat bands from getMarketPulseCitySnapshots with geo_snapshot_mv fallback, one honest editorial sentence per city from getCityContent, links to city page + homes-for-sale + open houses) -> other-areas compact ledger -> navy search CTA. CollectionPage + ItemList rendered inline + Breadcrumb JSON-LD (MetadataBlock). KbSectionTracker replaces EngagedSection telemetry (every .kb-root section[id] fires section_view). KbNav + KbFooter carry chrome (default SiteHeader/SiteFooter hidden for /cities via HideChrome). Body in main.kb-root + SmoothScrollProvider.

requiredComponents.name: KbNav
requiredComponents.section: chrome — transparent-over-hero top bar + full-screen menu. Inside .kb-root.

requiredComponents.name: KbSectionTracker
requiredComponents.section: tracking — section_view telemetry on every .kb-root section[id] (replaces EngagedSection). pageType=index.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: structured data — breadcrumb schema; CollectionPage + ItemList rendered inline.

requiredComponents.name: KbBreadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: breadcrumb — KB-styled Home > Cities (visual; JSON-LD is in MetadataBlock).

requiredComponents.name: SmoothScrollProvider
requiredComponents.section: KB shell — Lenis smooth scroll + GSAP wrapping the section stack.

requiredComponents.name: getRegionPulse
requiredComponents.section: hero — LIVE region stats (active count, median list, months-of-supply verdict). Honest em-dash empties.

requiredComponents.name: getMarketPulseCitySnapshots
requiredComponents.section: featured rows — live per-city stat bands (active / median / median DOM / verdict).

requiredComponents.name: cityHero
requiredComponents.section: featured rows — VERIFIED per-city photography from the Family 4 curation registry; unverified cities get the labeled regional fallback.

requiredComponents.name: getCityContent
requiredComponents.section: featured rows — one honest editorial sentence per city (hand-written content first, verifiable geographic fact fallback).

layoutComponents.name: SiteHeader
layoutComponents.section: hidden on /cities via HideChrome — KbNav renders instead.
layoutComponents.note: Not in requiredComponents because the gate checks the route file.

layoutComponents.name: SiteFooter
layoutComponents.section: hidden on /cities via HideChrome — KbFooter renders instead.
layoutComponents.note: Not in requiredComponents because the gate checks the route file.

Container / DisplayHeading / H2 / Eyebrow primitives (replaced by KB .wrap / .display / .sec-head / .sec-index)
Primary-cities name-and-number ledger (already replaced in v3.2 by full editorial rows with verified photography and live stat bands)
